content: The dream layers were wild. Nolan really went all in.
Solid pacing and great direction. Pleasantly surprised.
The updated story felt fresh, but the ending was a bit abrupt.
Pretty simple plot but entertaining enough for a weekend watch.
Could use stronger character development, but the idea was cool.
Good cinematography, surprisingly polished for its scale.
Enjoyable, though the script felt predictable at times.
Still one of the most creative sci-fi concepts ever made.
I liked the atmosphere, especially the soundtrack.
